name: being ignored
quote: My boss didn't even notice me.
description: A desire for a specific kind of attention along with the sense that you are not noticed appropriately.
perceptions: I want to be noticed in a certain way by a certain person or group.
That does not seem to be happening.
desires: desire to be perceived a certain way
examples: Your coworker isn't reading your proposal.
A person you're attracted to hasn't texted in days.

guidance.description: If you're feeling ignored, here are some references that may be of interest:

commentaries.quote: Sometimes people can hunger for more than bread. It is possible that our children, our husband, our wife, do not hunger for bread, do not need clothes, do not lack a house. But are we equally sure that none of them feels alone, abandoned, neglected, needing some affection? That, too, is poverty.
There's a lot of mediocrity being celebrated, and a lot of wonderful stuff being ignored or discouraged.
If you're being ignored, that's a good time to concentrate on finding yourself and creating your own mystery.
Facts do not cease to exist because they are ignored.
A spark neglected makes a mighty fire.
People tend to pay attention to the guy who shouts and ignore the one who whispers.
